labels.ORG: Organizations, including companies, political parties, bands, sports teams, newspapers and public institutions
labels.LOC: Countries, cities, regions, streets and specific places

rules: Annotate every target entity completely; ordinary occupations, generic references, times and quantities are not annotated on their own
Annotate contiguously and without overlap; a complete institution or place is not split into nested parts
Keep characters that are internal to the entity and exclude surrounding punctuation
Work titles carry no label of their own; avoid ambiguous cases that are not yet settled
status: Working rules derived from the current seed set, not yet a verified official corpus guideline
